segments.text: Phil and Luke become convinced there might be treasure hidden under the house. They both want to explore, but Phil is secretly terrified of the dark crawl space and all the insects down there.
segments.tts_text: [a natural conversational storyteller] Phil and Luke become convinced there might be treasure hidden under the house. They both want to explore, but Phil is secretly terrified of the dark crawl space and all the insects down there.

segments.text: So instead of going in himself, he sends Luke’s remote-controlled truck under the house with a camera attached.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller building gentle suspense] So instead of going in himself, he sends Luke’s remote-controlled truck under the house with a camera attached.

segments.text: Phil loses the truck. Luke is upset because it was a Christmas present from Jay, so he crawls under the house to get it himself. Then his belt gets caught on a pipe.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller with playful humor] Phil loses the truck. Luke is upset because it was a Christmas present from Jay, so he crawls under the house to get it himself. Then his belt gets caught on a pipe.

segments.text: The second Phil hears that Luke is trapped, he stops thinking about spiders and tight spaces and goes in after him.
segments.tts_text: [an animated storyteller explaining the scene] The second Phil hears that Luke is trapped, he stops thinking about spiders and tight spaces and goes in after him.

segments.text: Phil frees Luke, and for a moment he feels pretty heroic. Luke still wants his truck, though, so they keep going. Once they’re both under the house, Phil starts relaxing and even enjoys the adventure—right up until they find what look like dead bodies.

segments.text: They run out screaming and call the police. The “bodies” turn out to be old Halloween decorations left by the previous owner.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Haley is taking her driving test for the third time. If she fails again, she has to wait six months, so she’s already panicking before she gets in the car. Claire tells her to take three deep breaths and relax.

segments.text: Haley gets the same examiner who failed her before. During the test she gets overwhelmed and starts crying. He admits she reminds him of his own daughter, which is exactly why he’s so hard on her—he wants her to be safe. Haley gets another chance and finally passes.

segments.text: Mitchell and Cameron invite Lily’s pediatrician over for brunch because they’re desperate to become her favorite patients. During the meal, Lily suddenly says “Mommy.” Cameron is crushed and starts worrying that Lily somehow knows she’s missing a mother.

segments.text: The doctor reassures them that Lily has two parents who love her.

segments.text: Later, they find out what really happened: Lily’s doll says “Mommy” when you squeeze it. Lily was just copying the sound.

segments.text: Everybody is still afraid of something by the end. The difference is that most of them manage to move anyway.
